name: Rename
description: A symbol (class, method, or field) kept its behavior but changed name.

name: Move
description: A symbol kept its behavior and name but changed its enclosing type/location.

name: Add
description: A new symbol was introduced with no prior counterpart.

name: Remove
description: An existing symbol was deleted with no successor.

name: Change Signature
description: A method's parameter list and/or return type changed.

name: Extract Method
description: A fragment of an existing method's body was pulled out into a new method.

name: Mechanical Replacement
description: A whole-identifier textual substitution applied identically everywhere it was referenced.

name: Formatting Only
description: Only whitespace/formatting changed; the parsed structure is identical.

name: Add Constructor Parameter
description: A constructor gained a parameter that it assigns straight to a same-named field.

name: Change Field Annotations
description: A field kept its name and declared type but the set of annotations on it changed.

name: Change Control Flow
description: A method kept its signature but its conditions, branches or loops changed, so its runtime behavior may differ.

name: Pull Up
description: A member several classes declared moved up into a new common base class they now extend.

name: Modify Body
description: A method or constructor kept its signature but its body changed in a way no more specific transformation explains.
